finding: Partial: for every number field and f in Masullo.adeleBoxSpan on the actual adeles, the full K× sum at x=0 has a summable termwise majorant on each compact idele set. Clearing the translated support box and then the compact family of ideles puts all contributing indices in one fixed denominator lattice. A uniform lower bound on archimedean unit norms and Schwartz decay make the resulting lattice majorant summable. Both the complex and norm series converge compact-uniformly; reindexing and quotient descent yield the complex-linear operator into continuous functions on the actual idele class group, with the displayed representative formula. This does not equip the source with its Schwartz–Bruhat LF topology, show continuity in that topology, prove closedness of the theta kernel there, or realize its quotient as a strict LF-space. The stage-quotient proof on p. 231 omits strict transition checks; the separate S-stage projection argument requires preservation of the kernel, not merely the stage kernel pullback. The companion .godel/formalize/global-box-theta-operator.md records the source and a mathematical Q counterexample to preservation by the specific tensor projection, not a refutation of strict LF.
retry: Identify the box span with the global Schwartz–Bruhat space in a countable Fréchet stage model and prove continuity of the stage theta evaluations (or otherwise exhibit the kernel as the kernel of a continuous source operator). Prove that E_n+(ker Φ_F ∩ E_{n+1}) is closed in each next stage, or give a different strict presentation carrying the same quotient topology; check the nuclear Fréchet assertions separately. To recover the printed S-stage argument, prove valid quotient embeddings without using the failed kernel-preservation premise for the Hahn–Banach tensor projection.
